Priya: Heads-up — Large enterprise customer (FinCo) asked to swap Q3 Optimize rollout priority: they need Dedicated KMS + audit logging shipped earlier. This would move some Optimize items to Q4. Can we evaluate impact quickly?
Avery: Noted. Do we have acceptance criteria from FinCo or just a ask?
Priya: They sent a short list: KMS integration, per-request audit events, and SOC2-aligned retention. Link: https://finco.example/asks (redacted). They want canary by mid-August.
Samir: Mid-August is tight. Dedicated KMS touches onboarding, secrets, and infra templates. Roughly 6 dev-weeks + cert work unless we reuse the internal KMS shim.
Jules: If we deprioritize Optimize perf suggestions, what is the customer-visible delta? We lose some batching/quant recommendations — cost uplift ~10-15% on some workloads.
Avery: Two options: A) Pause Optimize features (move to Q4), accelerate KMS (ship by mid-August) B) Keep Optimize, ship a minimal KMS shim for FinCo with manual audit exports. Which has lower risk?
Claire: I vote for minimal shim option. Keeps Optimize roadmap momentum and reduces cross-team rework. But we must record technical debt and a clear cutover plan.
Samir: Minimal shim path estimate: 3 weeks dev + 1 week infra + 1 week compliance review. Would require a dedicated eng resource and a prioritized slot.
Priya: Customer asked for SLA on availability too. That implies Dedicated capacity + KMS. They are okay with a limited pilot only for billing-sensitive flows.
Avery: For decision: we need approval from GTM (sales/legal) + one infra eng commit. @Jules can you confirm whether sales will accept a pilot with manual audit exports instead of full automated logging?
Jules: I'll check with the AE. My read: AE will accept pilot if we label it "pilot / compliance-limited" and provide a roadmap showing full audit automation in Q4.
Priya: Proposed launch criteria for pilot (short list):
```
- KMS integration enabled for pilot tenants
- Manual audit export mechanism in place (CSV + secure S3)
- Documented runbook for incident + rotation
- Pilot SLAs defined and accepted by AE/legal
```
Avery: That looks reasonable. Risks: extra manual ops for team, and potential customer churn if audit automation takes too long. Add mitigation: 1-week cadence check-ins during pilot.
Samir: Resource ask: one infra engineer (ops) + two backend for 4 weeks. If we approve, I'll pull allocation.
Claire: Also add telemetry hooks so when we swap to full audit automation we can validate parity.
Priya: Decision path: Product approves minimal-shim pilot -> Sales signs pilot contract -> Eng allocates resources -> Pilot begins. Does product approve? :thinking_face: 
Avery: I approve proceeding with minimal-shim pilot, conditional on AE sign-off and legal ok.
Jules: Sales confirmed willingness to sign pilot term sheet with FinCo.
Priya: Great. @OpsBot can you create a follow-up ticket template for launch criteria and put it in the Q3 board?
OpsBot: Created ticket PROD-4921: "FinCo pilot — KMS shim + manual audit export" and added to board Q3. Owner: Samir.
Priya: Thanks. I'll update the shared OKR doc and reforecast Q3 deliverables/capacity. I'll ping again with exact scope swap numbers for quarterly reforecast. :slightly_smiling_face:
